brief: THIS IS THE BET: a 150-300 line diff is expected and welcome, take the swing. WIDE is the framing every visitor lands on and the only framing in the town with no vertical intent. QUARTERS[0] has no `y1`, so `viewFor()` short-circuits to `{s:1, ox:originX0, tp:topPad0}` and hands the job to `resize()`, which budgets `topPad = 4 + 9.6*cellH` of sky at every size, pushes 82% of any spare down as well, and never reads `sillTop()` — which all four fitted quarters do. MEASURE FIRST, at 1600x950 and 390x844: the share of canvas rows that is TOWN, against sky above and near-slate + sill below. My shot of HEAD at 390x844 reads ~27% sky and ~29% near roof + sill, so the town is under half a phone's frame and the plaza, river and far bank are not in it. Then give WIDE what #120 gave the quarters: an air/keep/share-shaped intent priced on `sillTop()` AND on the frame's aspect, so a tall narrow window leans in rather than banking sky. This is the camera, so re-run everything downstream of it: the ground cache and `gview`, the backdrop blit's `k = viewS/bview.s`, `FACES` screen-space registration, `unproject()`, `nearHidden()`, `groundPad()`, the follow camera, and every quarter's own fit.
successLooksLike: At 390x844 the opening frame is mostly town — the measured town share rises materially against HEAD and the plaza is in the picture — while 1600x950 keeps its composition (sky band, clock tower and church spire all still in frame, near band still legible) and every quarter's fit is unchanged.
avoid: Do not fix this by changing the DEFAULT QUARTER: #144 closed that as c217, and a first-run auto-zoom hides the wide shot the town is composed for. The change belongs in the WIDE fit itself. Do not redefine `sillTop()` and do not touch `drawSill`.
